tests.name: device contacts import is mounted and requires auth (rejected write probe)
device contacts removal is mounted and requires auth (rejected write probe)

tests.reason: Importing is a write to the shared production database, so it is never exercised on staging. E.164 normalisation, verified+discoverable-only phone matching, test/service exclusion, the pre-migration fallback (no phone matches, no unknown column written), the method/region hint and the removal route are proven by Jest; the migration's trigger and function behaviour is proven against a throwaway local Postgres by docs/validation/VTID-05057/migration-test.sql (outputs/migration-test.txt).
